correctness.rationale: The exact held-input flow reduces the trigger to a strictly increasing scalar ratio on the stated interval. Uniform upper and lower root bounds are proved. The sampled projective recurrence sends every nonzero initial direction to the unique eigenline, and solving the trigger equation on that eigenline yields the exact limit. The determinant and interval bounds rule out zero samples and Zeno accumulation; the upper-triangular products decay.
